name: Sith fighter
description: The Sith fighter, also known as the Sith interceptor, was a starfighter that formed the bulk of Darth Revan and Darth Malak's space forces during the Jedi Civil War.

data.name: Sith fighter
data.power: Unique prototype twin ion drive system of Rakatan design
